text_block_list.text: With the long-awaited Dream Fest just around the corner—

With an all-star lineup spanning multiple generations, public interest was soaring.
Even just walking down the street――

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey,
do you wanna go watch that race?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That interesting-looking one?
Not just current girls, but Umamusume from the past are in it too, right?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
It really has that festival vibe, doesn't it?
Since we're here, let's go check it out!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Oh, right,
I found an intro video for a Tracen Academy student.
Let me watch it to prepare—
choice_data_list: (Alright, this is sure to generate buzz.)
(Alright, this is sure to get people talking.)

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun.

Hearing someone call out to me, I turned around.
Standing there were Speed Symboli and—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Shh.
For now, please call me "Haa-chan"!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Since we're out in the city, just to be safe!
I put on a disguise♪
choice_data_list: (I feel like it's completely obvious, though...)

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Now then, 'Ha-chan.'
St. Lite is waiting, let us hurry."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Care to join us?
—On the market research squad, that is.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"—No, no, I'm not going.
When it comes down to it, it's just 'play.'"

Inside an eatery where hardcore racing fans gathered,
a heated debate about the "Dream Fest"
was underway.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Even if an old favorite is racing...
everything's different from how it used to be.
I don't wanna see my favorite looking past their prime...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, have a little fun!
It's a festival, right? No need to get so worked up."

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
I don't mean to rain on your parade, but...
Races are fun because girls in their prime
go all out against each other.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if we're talking about an all-star festival,
the Arima Kinen is more than enough.
I just... can't really get into it—

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"My, my...
How lively."

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"It is mixed with milk.
I happened upon some fine Whisky... a lovely Scotch."

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
This area has changed completely...
Such wonderful shops have opened up.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I am delighted that you like it.
It allows me to hear a variety of opinions,
so it has been very useful to me as well.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Ah, mineral water for me, please.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: I'd like some water too...—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
...I'm Har-chan right now, after all!
I'll have the same thing as St Lite, please♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
What will you do, Trainer?
The carrot splitting looks really fun!

I'm concerned about the reception of "Dream Fest."
It's not being welcomed warmly here... The core fans probably don't see any value in it.

"Furthermore, looking at social media outside the racing community,
it seems hardly anyone in the general public is talking about it.
I'm a bit uneasy about where things go from here..."
choice_data_list: I wonder if I'll be okay tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
No problem.
Because it's the "first," after all.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh.
Then, here is my question.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Has there been any race lately that garnered
this much attention among the fans?"

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Right? In the first place, it seemed like
her passion for racing itself had been fading lately.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: However, just take a look—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan E
text_block_list.text:
Crossing generations? That sounds pretty amazing.
Maybe I'll tune into a stream for the first time in a while~.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"—Thanks to this festive commotion, attention has definitely spiked, to say the least.
Even if it's just within our circle, that is."

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
First, if they can just remember that racing is fun,
that's already a full 100 points!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
What lies beyond that...
depends on what we do from here on.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm sure it'll be fine!
I just know it.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: If you put your heart into expressing it, your feelings will definitely reach them!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Come on, we've gotta get into
festival mode too♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
An All-Star race... A true dream matchup!
And <nickname>-chan will be there too.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
How about it?
Aren't you getting excited?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: “—Now, let's cheer with all our might! For your “Stella”!”
